bull.b: Zeta is showing durable demand through rapid revenue growth, larger enterprise accounts, higher ARPU and broader product adoption. Increasing use across multiple use cases and channels can deepen customer relationships and support recurring expansion.

Robust free cash flow indicates the platform is converting scale into cash despite near break-even GAAP earnings. Rising FCF and targeted 63% conversion support reinvestment, debt management and strategic flexibility over the medium term.

Proprietary data, identity assets, AI adoption and major technology integrations can strengthen Zeta’s competitive position in enterprise martech. Higher retention among AI users suggests product depth may increase switching costs and customer lifetime value.

bear.t: GAAP profitability is not yet durable
bear.b: The company has improved materially but has not yet established consistent GAAP profitability. Continued operating losses and thin operating margins leave results vulnerable to cost inflation, execution shortfalls and changes in revenue mix.

Greater exposure to agency-led social activity can dilute gross margin relative to higher-margin platform revenue. If this mix persists as growth accelerates, it could constrain margin expansion and reduce the benefit of operating leverage.

bear.t: Execution risk in organic growth and new products
bear.b: Headline growth includes acquisition contributions, while organic expansion is lower and ZBI monetization may take longer with new enterprise buyers. This creates dependence on successful integration, cross-selling and timely conversion of the pipeline.
